experiment.name: core_quantitative_experiment
experiment.research_status: NESTED PSEUDO-OUT-OF-SAMPLE; NOT AN UNTOUCHED HOLDOUT

clock.return_index_semantics: row t is the close t-1 to close t return
clock.execution: close t after old holdings earn row t
clock.first_new_weight_return: first return row strictly after t

walkforward.outer_start_rule: first scheduled date after four complete quarterly pseudo-OOS validation folds, each with a 504-observation fit window

uncertainty.box_rho_rule: empirical coverage quantile of max absolute standardized bootstrap mean error
uncertainty.ellipsoid_rho_rule: square root of empirical coverage quantile of regularized Mahalanobis bootstrap mean error
uncertainty.kappa_rule: empirical coverage quantile of maximum positive relative bootstrap IEWMA diagonal error

risk_matching.definition: common numerical annualized volatility upper bound
risk_matching.risk_for_diagonal_robust: headline IEWMA covariance plus calibrated kappa times its diagonal

costs.interpretation: scenarios, not historical ETF-specific execution-cost estimates

limitations: The public ETF panel is survivor-conditioned and is not survivorship-bias-free.
Historical inactive/dead funds and terminal returns are unavailable.
Execution is a close-t approximation after the return ending at t.
Cash earns zero because no validated time-aligned risk-free series is stored.
Transaction-cost rates are scenarios, not empirically estimated ETF-specific costs.
The historical period was already observed during earlier project development.
Final statistical performance inference is reported separately in the final analysis.
Static asset-class labels are not point-in-time classifications.
